WITH RECURSIVE
juniors AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Juniors'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN juniors j ON t.parent_id = j.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    WHERE s.year = 2017 AND s.theme_id IN (SELECT id FROM juniors)
),
current_versions AS (
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_num, MAX(version) AS version
    FROM u_composition
    GROUP BY parent_kind, parent_num
),
exploded AS (
    SELECT c.parent_num AS set_num, c.child_kind, c.child_num, c.color_id, c.is_spare, c.qty::BIGINT AS qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN current_versions cv
      ON c.parent_kind = cv.parent_kind AND c.parent_num = cv.parent_num AND c.version = cv.version
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'set' AND c.parent_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.set_num, c.child_kind, c.child_num, c.color_id, c.is_spare, e.qty * c.qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN current_versions cv
      ON cv.parent_kind = e.child_kind AND cv.parent_num = e.child_num
    JOIN u_composition c
      ON c.parent_kind = e.child_kind AND c.parent_num = e.child_num AND c.version = cv.version
    WHERE e.child_kind IN ('set','minifig')
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) AS total_parts
FROM exploded
WHERE child_kind = 'part' AND is_spare = FALSE;
```

WITH RECURSIVE racers_themes AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Racers'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN racers_themes r ON t.parent_id = r.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN racers_themes rt ON s.theme_id = rt.id
    WHERE s.year = 2012
),
set_parts AS (
    SELECT ts.set_num,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.qty), 0) AS total_parts
    FROM target_sets ts
    LEFT JOIN u_explosion e
           ON e.root_kind = 'set'
          AND e.root_num = ts.set_num
          AND e.is_current = TRUE
          AND e.item_kind = 'part'
          AND e.is_spare = FALSE
    GROUP BY ts.set_num
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_parts), 2) AS avg_parts
FROM set_parts;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE arch_themes AS (
    SELECT id FROM themes WHERE name = 'Architecture'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.id FROM themes t JOIN arch_themes a ON t.parent_id = a.id
),
target_sets AS (
    SELECT s.set_num
    FROM sets s
    JOIN arch_themes a ON s.theme_id = a.id
    WHERE s.year = 2019
),
current_versions AS (
    SELECT parent_num, MAX(version) AS v
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
    GROUP BY parent_num
),
set_parts AS (
    SELECT e.root_num AS set_num, SUM(e.qty) AS total_parts
    FROM u_explosion e
    JOIN current_versions cv ON cv.parent_num = e.root_num AND cv.v = e.root_version
    WHERE e.root_kind = 'set'
      AND e.is_current
      AND e.item_kind = 'part'
      AND e.is_spare = FALSE
      AND e.root_num IN (SELECT set_num FROM target_sets)
    GROUP BY e.root_num
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sp.total_parts, 0)), 2) AS avg_parts
FROM target_sets ts
LEFT JOIN set_parts sp ON sp.set_num = ts.set_num;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE theme_hierarchy AS (
    -- Find the 'Juniors' theme and all its sub-themes
    SELECT id, name, parent_id
    FROM themes
    WHERE name = 'Juniors'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT t.id, t.name, t.parent_id
    FROM themes t
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON t.parent_id = th.id
),
sets_2018_juniors AS (
    -- All sets from 2018 in Juniors theme (including sub-themes)
    SELECT s.set_num, s.name, s.year, s.theme_id
    FROM sets s
    JOIN theme_hierarchy th ON s.theme_id = th.id
    WHERE s.year = 2018
),
-- Get current inventory version for each set
set_current_version AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_num AS set_num,
        MAX(version) AS current_version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'set'
    GROUP BY parent_num
),
-- Get current inventory version for each minifig
minifig_current_version AS (
    SELECT 
        parent_num AS fig_num,
        MAX(version) AS current_version
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE parent_kind = 'minifig'
    GROUP BY parent_num
),
-- Recursive explosion: start from sets, traverse through nested sets and minifigs
exploded AS (
    -- Base: direct contents of each 2018 Juniors set (current version)
    SELECT 
        s.set_num AS root_set,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.is_spare,
        uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM sets_2018_juniors s
    JOIN set_current_version cv ON s.set_num = cv.set_num
    JOIN u_composition uc ON uc.parent_kind = 'set' 
        AND uc.parent_num = s.set_num 
        AND uc.version = cv.current_version
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: expand nested sets and minifigs
    SELECT 
        e.root_set,
        uc.child_kind,
        uc.child_num,
        uc.color_id,
        uc.is_spare,
        e.total_qty * uc.qty AS total_qty
    FROM exploded e
    JOIN u_composition uc ON 
        CASE 
            WHEN e.child_kind = 'set' THEN 
                uc.parent_kind = 'set' AND uc.parent_num = e.child_num
            WHEN e.child_kind = 'minifig' THEN 
                uc.parent_kind = 'minifig' AND uc.parent_num = e.child_num
            ELSE FALSE
        END
    JOIN set_current_version cv ON 
        CASE 
            WHEN e.child_kind = 'set' THEN cv.set_num = e.child_num
            ELSE TRUE
        END
    JOIN minifig_current_version mcv ON 
        CASE 
            WHEN e.child_kind = 'minifig' THEN mcv.fig_num = e.child_num
            ELSE TRUE
        END
    WHERE 
        CASE 
            WHEN e.child_kind = 'set' THEN uc.version = cv.current_version
            WHEN e.child_kind = 'minifig' THEN uc.version = mcv.current_version
            ELSE FALSE
        END
        AND e.child_kind IN ('set', 'minifig')  -- Only expand sets and minifigs, not parts
)
-- Sum quantities of all parts (non-spare) across all levels
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_qty), 0)::BIGINT AS total_parts
FROM exploded
WHERE child_kind = 'part'
  AND is_spare = FALSE;
```
